ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, PD is tangent to $\odot O$ at point C, and intersects the extension line of AB at point D, and $\angle D = 2\angle CAD$. What is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OA=OC$,\\
it follows that $\angle A=\angle ACO$,\\
thus $\angle COD=\angle A+\angle ACO=2\angle A$,\\
given $\angle D=2\angle A$,\\
it implies $\angle D=\angle COD$,\\
since line $PD$ is tangent to circle $O$ at point $C$,\\
therefore $\angle OCD=90^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle D=\angle COD=\boxed{45^\circ}$;

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, and PD is tangent to $\odot O$ at point C. PD intersects the extension of AB at point D, and $\angle D = 2\angle CAD$. What is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
raw_record.answer: Solution: Since $OA=OC$, it follows that $\angle A=\angle ACO$, thus $\angle COD=\angle A+\angle ACO=2\angle A$. Given $\angle D=2\angle A$, it implies $\angle D=\angle COD$. Since line $PD$ is tangent to circle $O$ at point $C$, therefore $\angle OCD=90^\circ$. Hence $\angle D=\angle COD=\boxed{45^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: There is a circle in the figure, AB is a horizontal diameter, A is at the left end of the circle, B is at the right end of the circle, and O is on AB and is the center of the circle; AB is extended to the right to point D. Point C is located at the upper right of the circle, line PD passes through C, and is tangent to the circle at C, and this tangent line continues to intersect the extension line of AB at D.

Reasoning: Let α = ∠CAD. Because A, O, B, D are on the same straight line, and D is on the extension line of AB, ray AD and AO are in the same direction, therefore ∠CAD = ∠CAO = α. Also because OA and OC are both radii of the circle, OA = OC, triangle AOC is an isosceles triangle, thus ∠ACO = ∠CAO = α. Since OD is the reverse extension direction of OA, the exterior angle ∠COD = ∠CAO + ∠ACO = 2α. The problem gives ∠D = 2∠CAD = 2α, so ∠D = ∠COD. Also because PD is the tangent to circle O at point C, the radius OC is perpendicular to tangent CD, that is, ∠OCD = 90°. In right triangle OCD, the other two angles ∠D and ∠COD are equal, therefore each is 45°. So ∠D = 45°.

整体数学推理、最终答案以及与 Method Draft 的一致性都很好，且满足“先描述图像，再推理”的顺序。但图像描述中“图中还连接了 AC 和 BC”不够忠实：图中明确可见的是 AC、OC、AB/AD 以及切线 PD/CD；BC 并不明显是已画出的线段。若后续要使用三角形 ABC 和切线-弦定理，应改为“连接辅助线 BC”或“考虑由 A、B、C 三点形成的三角形 ABC”，不要说图中已经画出了 BC。
major_failures: 存在一个未充分图像支撑的视觉 claim：候选推理称图中连接了 BC，但附图中更明显的是 OC 半径，BC 不是清楚的已绘制线段。
